name: Cap Booster
description: Burns a booster cell from cargo and returns 120 GJ to the capacitor at once. The bay holds 0.25 m³ of cells and a cycle takes five seconds. Iškoven builds it for the hulls that cannot afford to wait out a recharge, and every fleet on the ring stocks the cells beside the ammunition.

name: Cap Recharger
description: Passive circuitry that takes 45 seconds off the capacitor's recharge time, with no activation and no draw of its own. Iškoven builds both capacitor modules, and the house's fitting desks order them together.
